_comment: STILL image generation (studio headshots and portraits).
Hand this whole file to the image model, or paste one of the
strings under 'prompts'. GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render
is the reference image that video.json requires.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice for a representative South African line-up; not inferred from any name
identity.build: tall and lean, straight-backed, long hands

face: long oval face, high cheekbones, deep-set dark brown eyes, defined jaw, deep nasolabial lines from decades of speaking, warm deep-brown skin with even undertone
hair: close-cropped hair receding at the temples, uniformly grey-white; neatly trimmed short beard, salt-heavy with a darker moustache

wardrobe.teaching: charcoal or navy three-piece suit worn without the jacket while teaching: crisp white shirt, buttoned waistcoat, dark tie held by a plain clip, sleeves precisely folded to mid-forearm
alternates: grey waistcoat over pale blue shirt, no tie
full charcoal suit with jacket for headshots

presence.posture: stands square and still, weight even, chin slightly lifted; gestures only to point at a step on the board
presence.default_expression: composed, attentive, the faint approval of a teacher watching a student get it right; smiles rarely and briefly
presence.energy: contained authority - the room quiets without him raising his voice
presence.spoken_register: formal, low and warm, unhurried but brisk; no filler

_environment_reference: ordered classroom, board filled with neatly aligned algebra in straight lines, desks in rows, late-afternoon light
_environment_note: NOT used for platform imagery - tutors are shot in studio. Owner, 2026-07-28: the student left the teachers in the classroom, so the platform does not show one. Kept only as character reference if a composite is ever wanted.
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 52-58 year old Black South African male teacher. long oval face, high cheekbones, deep-set dark brown eyes, defined jaw, deep nasolabial lines from decades of speaking, warm deep-brown skin with even undertone. Hair: close-cropped hair receding at the temples, uniformly grey-white; neatly trimmed short beard, salt-heavy with a darker moustache. Wearing charcoal or navy three-piece suit worn without the jacket while teaching: crisp white shirt, buttoned waistcoat, dark tie held by a plain clip, sleeves precisely folded to mid-forearm. thin gold-wire round spectacles. Hands relaxed and empty, holding nothing. Expression: composed, attentive, the faint approval of a teacher watching a student get it right; smiles rarely and briefly. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.
prompts.studio: Studio portrait of a 52-58 year old Black South African male teacher, waist-up. tall and lean, straight-backed, long hands. long oval face, high cheekbones, deep-set dark brown eyes, defined jaw, deep nasolabial lines from decades of speaking, warm deep-brown skin with even undertone. Hair: close-cropped hair receding at the temples, uniformly grey-white; neatly trimmed short beard, salt-heavy with a darker moustache. Wearing charcoal or navy three-piece suit worn without the jacket while teaching: crisp white shirt, buttoned waistcoat, dark tie held by a plain clip, sleeves precisely folded to mid-forearm. thin gold-wire round spectacles. Expression: composed, attentive, the faint approval of a teacher watching a student get it right; smiles rarely and briefly. Plain empty seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop, evenly lit, bare from edge to edge. two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop. full-frame, 50mm f/2, waist-up. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, eyes alive and focused ON the lens rather than through it, moist eye surface with a bright asymmetric catchlight from the key light and a weaker one from the fill, visible iris striations and limbal ring, individual lower lashes, faint pink at the inner corner and a visible tear line, slight crinkle of the muscle at the outer corners, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, glassy doll eyes, vacant thousand-yard stare, identical catchlights in both eyes, flat matte irises, eyes looking through the camera, mismatched gaze direction, classroom, school desks, chalkboard, whiteboard, notice boards, posters, any writing or notation in frame, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, set dressing, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the cinematic terms are deliberate - image models drift toward a film-still look (grade, motion blur, flare) and then the render stops reading as a photograph

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, seamless warm neutral grey studio backdrop
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn

studio.lighting: two-light studio set: large softbox key at 45 degrees, soft fill opposite, gentle rim light to lift the shoulders off the backdrop
studio.framing: waist-up, centred or slightly off-centre with clean space beside the head for overlaid text
studio.backdrop: seamless warm neutral grey paper, evenly lit, no props, no furniture, no set dressing

_hands_rule: No held objects in any portrait prompt. The original generator inserted accessory #2 into a 'Holding one simple item' sentence regardless of whether it could be held, which is how a beaded wristband, a bangle, a watch and a pencil behind the ear all ended up 'held'. Objects belong in environment shots, on a surface.
_language_group_note: The cultural/language group this character belongs to. Recorded explicitly because it was previously only inferable from the surname, so a rename could change it silently. It does NOT alter the face - heritage drives appearance; language_group drives naming, and any traditional dress named in wardrobe.
_accessories_vs_objects: accessories = WORN ONLY, and portrait prompts may use them freely. objects = things this tutor teaches with; they belong in environment/classroom shots resting on a surface, and must NEVER enter a headshot or studio prompt. The two were one list, which is why held props kept reappearing: any template reaching into it could pull out a cash tin or a phone.
